description: Fog, Dust Storm and haze - Doha International Airport (2011 - 2024) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Civil Aviation Authority. "This dataset provides monthly counts of days with fog, dust storms, and haze at Doha International Airport. Each weather phenomenon is recorded based on a defined visibility threshold: fog and dust storms are counted when visibility drops below 1 kilometer, and haze is counted when visibility drops below 5 kilometers. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher Civil Aviation Authority. Its tags are fog, haze, dust storm, weather, visibility. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-05-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and air transport studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
